Keep it frozen (it already declares sub_02016F40(void *, void *, struct UnkStruct_0207294C *, u8)). Put the new struct typedefs and the other exports in include/unk_02016EDC_internal.h (or local to the .c). Several if/else chains must stay chains, not switches: sub_02017A84 (8,10,9,11), sub_02017A1C (0x1B, 0x1D, then assert ==0x1C), and sub_0201790C (8..0xE).

Stack layout of the u8 register/mode locals (sp+0..3) and the int locals (sp+4/8/0xC) in the operand-decode helpers and opcodes: declaration order controls the offsets, so expect to permute declarations or use a small u8 array.
sub_020173C8 uses the signed x % 0x10000 idiom; sub_02017488 uses signed -x/8.
u8 loop counters (lsl/lsr #24) in sub_020170FC, sub_02017220 and sub_02017C78; int counter in sub_02016EDC.
sub_02017C78 loads argc once through the interior pool label _020F61C0 and once through &table[type]; one table struct should produce both.

Rodata order: the subtask-type table (60 bytes) comes before the 34-entry opcode table. Both reference functions, so forward-declare every static callback before the tables, or place the tables after the functions (rodata emission order is what matters).
notes: This file is the Pokepic animation script VM: a manager with N slots, each running a bytecode script from NARC a_0_9_0 (90) through a SysTask. There are 34 opcodes, 8 registers, loop and conditional-set operations, and up to 4 concurrent interpolation subtasks (types 0-4: sine/cosine wave, linear, lerp, clamped ramp) writing into slot fields 0x68..0x78. Only the five sub_02016EDC..sub_02017088 functions are exported (in the .inc); all others can be static. No .data/.bss. No DECL_CHUNK_EX involvement.
